title: On-the-ground field observations by IRIB correspondent, regarding oil pollution along the southern coast of the town of Suza on Qeshm Island.
text:
On-the-ground field observations by IRIB correspondent, regarding oil pollution along the southern coast of the town of Suza on Qeshm Island."

"IRIB correspondent (Farsi): "As you can see, pollution is observed on this beach. All these objects on the shore, all these shells, and the black stains and oil spills are visible. Investigations into the origin and cause of this pollution are ongoing, and we will await the results of these investigations.
